Described Patient Chart Manager features: clinical/admin documentation, scheduling, billing, auto-filing, voice recognition, digital imaging, customizable interface. Target: solo to 100-provider practices.

Described Intellect Practice Management: scheduling, billing, payment reports, insurance claims, eligibility verification, aging reports, CPT tracking, 1300+ insurance companies, multi-location support.

Detailed PCM product description: exam room documentation, charge posting, e-prescribing, voice recognition, digital imaging, lab interface, paperless fax/email, DICOM/HL7 compatible. Mentions OnSTAFF, PocketSTAFF, WebSTAFF integration.
EHR software profile: cloud and on-premise deployment, 12+ specialties supported, HL7/DICOM compatible, solo to 50+ physicians. Tracks charts, appointments, prescriptions, labs, allergies, images.
Vendor profile: founded 1983, Pasadena CA, Dublin Ireland office. Serves U.S. market. Customers include NSR Medical, Advanced Radiology of Beverly Hills, Pomona Pediatrics.
2008 silver anniversary: 25 years without merging or VC. Serves 10,000+ physicians. Products developed in-house on common database. Long-term customer retention highlighted (25-year customer).
Company profile: founded 1983 by Barry Ardelan, Pasadena CA. ONC-certified EHR for physician practices.
